Name: Predictable Retaining Soil
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]No more RNG on Retaining Soil. Upgrade your watering can even on sunny days![/size]

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=5]Settings[/size]
Defaults are underlined.
0: will never retain water (effectively disabling any effect the retaining soil has)
-1: will always retain water
[list]
[*][b][font=Courier New]BasicRetainingSoilDays[/font][/b]: At least [font=Courier New]-1[/font] (default [font=Courier New][u]1[/u][/font]).
[*][b][font=Courier New]QualityRetainingSoilDays[/font][/b]: At least [font=Courier New]-1[/font] (default [font=Courier New][u]3[/u][/font]).
[*][b][font=Courier New]DeluxeRetainingSoilDays[/font][/b]: At least [font=Courier New][u]-1[/u][/font].
[/list]

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/PredictableRetainingSoil]here[/url].

Manifest.Name: Predictable Retaining Soil
Manifest.Description: Makes all retaining soils stay watered a specified number of days (instead of being random).
Manifest.Author: Shockah
